# Robin Gerth

> Full-stack developer (Vue, Angular, Django, Shopware 6). Helps small and medium-sized businesses save time with AI automation. Site available in English (/en) and German (/de).

## Role & focus
- Full-stack developer with hands-on experience in productive business systems: Shopware 6, backend logic, REST APIs, Vue and Angular frontends, selected Kotlin adjustments for Android.
- Helps small and medium-sized businesses save time with AI automation, as a part-time side business alongside the employed role.
- Based in the Waldshut district in the German-Swiss border region; available on site for businesses nearby and remotely elsewhere.
- Clarifies requirements carefully, keeps effort, value and risk visible, and delivers software that stays understandable in day to day operation.
- Uses AI-assisted development tools for research, code analysis and refactoring; the technical responsibility stays with the developer.

## Consulting & automation offers
- **Service as a Software** – takes on recurring work such as reporting, content maintenance or customer enquiries as an ongoing, automated service.
- **Web app implementation** – builds custom web applications and internal tools, from the initial requirement through to productive operation.
- **Agentic coding workshops** – shows development teams how to integrate AI coding agents into existing workflows in a controlled way.
- **Software & API audits** – reviews existing systems, interfaces and automations for weaknesses and unused potential.
- **MVP development** – turns a business idea into a lean prototype that tests assumptions quickly.
- **Quick check** – short conversation about where automation pays off in a given business, about 30 minutes, free of charge.

## Tech stack
Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, Shopware 6, PHP, Symfony, Kotlin, REST APIs, Linux, Git.

## Case studies
- Internal knowledge management & RAG chatbot – n8n / Qdrant / Microsoft Teams / Entra ID RAG-based chatbot for internal knowledge search with hybrid search and reranking. Internal project built in the employed full-stack developer role at ABC Design, not a client project of the side business.
- Join – Kanban task tool (JavaScript, Firebase).
- DaBubble – Messenger application (Angular, TypeScript, Firebase).
- Videoflix – Full-stack streaming platform (Python, Django REST Framework, Angular).
- El Pollo Loco – Browser game (JavaScript, Canvas, OOP).
